author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Emergent Communication - Basic Signaling Game (Fixed Init)
abstract: This corrected submission fixes a ValueError in the previous experiment on emergent communication. The 'signal_strategy' dictionary in the 'CommunicatingResourceAgent' is now explicitly initialized with all possible signals during agent creation, preventing 'max()' from being called on an empty sequence. This multi-agent simulation explores how explicit signaling influences collective outcomes, cooperation levels, and the potential emergence of stable communication protocols in a resource-sharing scenario.
